user.title: Trimlight Edge
user.description: Enter the controller's IP address. Controllers found on this network: {found}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the controller on TCP port 8586.
error.busy: The controller didn't answer. It talks to one app at a time, so another app is probably connected to it, such as the Trimlight app on a phone. Close that app and submit again.

show_saved_effect.name: Show saved effect
show_saved_effect.description: Shows an effect stored in the controller's own library, by its ID.

effect_id.name: Effect ID
effect_id.description: Library slot number of the effect.

show_pattern.name: Show pattern
show_pattern.description: Shows a custom pattern with your own colours, like the app's pattern editor. It is not saved on the controller.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: Up to 30 colours, in order. Each is a name (red), a hex code (#ff8800) or [R, G, B].

dots.name: Dots per colour
dots.description: How many dots each colour covers (1-90). One number for all colours, or a list with one per colour.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: 0-255. Defaults to the Effect speed setting.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: 0-255. Defaults to the light's current brightness.

save_effect.name: Save effect
save_effect.description: Saves an effect in the controller's library, so the app, schedules and the effect list can use it. Without a pattern, it saves what the lights show now. A saved effect with the same name is replaced.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: To save a pattern instead of what is showing: how its colours move.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: The pattern's colours, as for Show pattern.

dots.name: Dots per colour
dots.description: 1-90; one number, or one per colour.

rename_saved_effect.name: Rename saved effect
rename_saved_effect.description: Renames an effect in the controller's library.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: The saved effect's name, as in the light's effect list.

delete_saved_effect.name: Delete saved effect
delete_saved_effect.description: Deletes an effect from the controller's library. Effects used by a schedule or the combined effect cannot be deleted.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: The saved effect's name, as in the light's effect list.

set_overlay.name: Set lightning or snow
set_overlay.description: Adds lightning or snow over a saved effect whenever it plays, or removes it.

set_combined_effect.name: Set combined effect
set_combined_effect.description: Sets the saved effects the combined effect plays in turn. Schedules can use the combined effect.

effects.name: Effects
effects.description: Saved effect names, in playing order.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Adds a calendar schedule, or changes one when a schedule ID is given. It shows a saved effect every night between the dates, every year, when Mode is Timer.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: The schedule to change, shown in the calendar event. Leave empty to add a new one.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: A saved effect's name, or Combined effect.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First night. The year is ignored. Leave empty when the schedule follows a holiday.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last night; defaults to the start date. An end before the start runs over New Year.

holiday.name: Holiday
holiday.description: Instead of dates: follow a holiday whose date moves, such as Easter or Thanksgiving. Home Assistant moves the schedule to the holiday's next dates once they have passed.

holiday_start_offset.name: Days from the holiday to the first night
holiday_start_offset.description: Negative is before the holiday, so -2 starts two days before it.

holiday_end_offset.name: Days from the holiday to the last night

on_time.name: On time
on_time.description: When the lights turn on each night; or use On at sunset or sunrise.

on_sun.name: On at sunset or sunrise
on_sun.description: Instead of an on time: follow sunset or sunrise. Home Assistant works the time out from its location and updates it each day.

on_offset.name: On offset
on_offset.description: Minutes after sunset or sunrise; negative is before.

off_time.name: Off time
off_time.description: When they turn off; a time before the on time means the next morning. Or use Off at sunset or sunrise.

off_sun.name: Off at sunset or sunrise
off_sun.description: Instead of an off time: follow sunset or sunrise.

off_offset.name: Off offset
off_offset.description: Minutes after sunset or sunrise; negative is before.

waiting_id.name: Waiting schedule
waiting_id.description: A holiday schedule Home Assistant is holding off the controller, which this one replaces. The Trimlight page fills this in.

set_daily_schedule.name: Set daily schedule
set_daily_schedule.description: Changes daily schedule 1 or 2 in one go. Daily schedules run when Mode is Timer. Settings left out stay as they are.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: A saved effect's name, or Combined effect.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Today only, every day, weekdays or weekend.

on_sun.name: On at sunset or sunrise
on_sun.description: Instead of an on time: follow sunset or sunrise. Home Assistant works the time out from its location and updates it each day.

on_offset.name: On offset
on_offset.description: Minutes after sunset or sunrise; negative is before.

off_time.name: Off time
off_time.description: When they turn off; a time before the on time means the next morning.

off_sun.name: Off at sunset or sunrise
off_sun.description: Instead of an off time: follow sunset or sunrise.

off_offset.name: Off offset
off_offset.description: Minutes after sunset or sunrise; negative is before.

show_effect.name: Show built-in effect
show_effect.description: Shows one of the 180 built-in effects with its speed, length, direction and brightness in a single command.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: The built-in effect's name, as in the light's effect list.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: 0-255; defaults to the Effect speed setting.

length.name: Length
length.description: 1-90 dots; defaults to the Effect length setting.

reverse.name: Reverse
reverse.description: Run it the other way; defaults to the Reverse direction setting.

start_music.name: Start music effect
start_music.description: Starts one of the 18 music effects, driven by sound on the controller's own audio (AUX) input. Settings left out keep the controller's current ones.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: The music effect's name, for example Full Color Rhythm Spectrum.
